status: PREPARED FOR OWNER REVIEW; no phase gate granted
meaning: Every accepted requirement has at least one justified validation route, and every obligation reaches existing accepted requirements. Counts concern traceability only, not complete clause-level test design, executed tests, product quality, or independent assurance.
method: Full direct VAL trace fields expanded; published forward mirrors compared where present; explicit endpoints and source versions checked; source statements and the listed controlled/refinement chains inspected. New controlled correspondences are explicit review evidence and do not alter accepted requirement or validation wording.
scope_limits: This is a documentation audit, not a TDG product artifact or import/export schema.
An upstream refinement relation alone is not proof that every downstream validation covers every clause; only the listed semantically justified routes are used.
No independent reviewer was used. Later test analysis must decompose full obligations, including negative cases and all supported paths.
Administrative acceptance derives from closure records and Owner decisions, not stale PROPOSED/PENDING labels retained inside historical snapshots.
